author: Lauren DuBois
title: Keith Urban 'has a lot to say' about Nicole Kidman split as he prepares 'revenge' album - NewsBreak
text:
By Lauren DuBois ,
3 hours ago
Keith Urban is allegedly seeking to get "revenge" on ex-wife Nicole Kidman following their 2025 split, and is doing so via an upcoming album that his ex is reportedly "freaking out" about.
Urban , 58, and the Oscar winner , also 58, were married for 19 years before announcing their split in 2025. The former couple, who share daughters, Sunday Rose, 17, and Faith Margaret, 15, finalized their divorce in January.
Now, following reports that the actress was seen getting "cozy" with her Scarpetta co-star Simon Baker , the Grammy Award winner is working on new music, and some of it is alleged to be related to his divorce.
Break-up albums are considered normal for many celebrities, as several artists channel their feelings about their splits into their music.
According to reports, for Urban, this means the "mother of all break-up albums."
Urban is allegedly plotting a revenge album following their divorce "Move over Taylor Swift and Lily Allen, Keith's been charting his emotional journey since his breakup with Nicole through songwriting, and it turns out he has a lot to say," a source told Woman's Day.
The source also shared that Kidman is concerned about the possible music and is very worried about what could come out in the tracks.
"Nicole's freaking out," the source claimed. "Even though Keith's limited with what he can and can't say under the terms of the divorce, she was never able to make stipulations about his music."
"It's the only outlet he has to express himself, and she's right to be worried."
Urban allegedly wants to channel his emotions in his new music It's a major change from the songs Urban previously wrote about and for his then-wife during their marriage.
The track Once in a Lifetime from 2006 was something he had previously shared, which was about Kidman and about the time while they were engaged, where she had expressed fear about marrying him, and he wrote the song to "reassure her." Similarly, Got it Right this time, also from 2006, was also about her.
He later released Thank You about her in 2009, before his chart-topping hit with Carrie Underwood, The Fighter, in 2016, which he had said was a vow to continue protecting her even when things got tough. His final song about her, Gemini, from 2018, included the lyric, "She's a maniac in bed/But a brainiac in her head."
Concerns that Urban might release a breakup album come as rumors emerged that Kidman had moved on with Baker, 56.

Kidman is allegedly "freaking out" over the new music During the show's premiere in New York City, the two were spotted holding hands, and Kidman revealed their chemistry "just vibrates" while Baker said, "I don't kiss and tell."
Urban was allegedly hurt by the flirty encounters, which may be fueling the flames of his alleged songwriting.
"He's finding it therapeutic to offload into his music, but he hopes to be in a much better place when he makes the final cut on what will, auspiciously, be his 13th original album," the source told.
"Only time will tell what will happen."
5
